questionTitle: cy Only challenging the legal validity of the landlord’s notice
validSection13: cy Your landlord must give you a valid section 13 notice before increasing your rent.
bulletHeading: cy A valid section 13 notice must:
bullet1: cy give the correct notice period (at least 2 months)
bullet2: cy not increase the rent within 52 weeks of the last increase
bullet3: cy start the increase on the correct date
bullet4: cy include your correct details, such as your name and address
bullet5: cy be signed by the landlord
stillChallengeIncrease: cy You can still challenge the rent increase even if the notice is valid.
downloadPaperForm: cy If you only want to challenge the legal validity of the landlord’s notice, you must use our downloadable paper form to apply (PDF, 848KB).
